d: Binance is a leading global blockchain ecosystem behind the world’s largest cryptocurrency exchange by trading volume and registered users. We are trusted by 300+ million people in 100+ countries for our industry-leading security, user fund transparency, trading engine speed, deep liquidity, and an unmatched portfolio of digital-asset products. Binance offerings range from trading and finance to education, research, payments, institutional services, and more. Our mission is to increase the freedom of money and financial access for people around the world.

We are building a suite of tokenized equity capital markets products from the ground up, and are looking for a Business Development professional to originate, structure, and drive deals across the product line. You will join a small, high-impact team and take ownership of the external relationships and deal pipeline end to end.

This is a 0-to-1 opportunity for a self-starter with an established capital markets network who wants to contribute to building a product from inception. The successful candidate will own the origination and negotiation of deals — reaching out to issuers, partners, and financial institutions, growing the pipeline, and driving opportunities through to close.
q: Minimum 5 years of relevant experience in business development, equity capital markets (ECM) origination, coverage/relationship management, investment banking, or capital raising.
An established network across VC/PE, investment banking, issuers, and institutional relationships, with the ability to open doors and originate from day one.
A demonstrable track record of sourcing, negotiating, and closing deals or mandates.
Strong understanding of the equity capital markets and the mechanics of capital raising (IPOs, follow-on offerings, and related transactions).
Excellent communication and negotiation skills, with the ability to represent the firm to senior external counterparts.
A genuine self-starter — comfortable with ambiguity, operating independently, and building a pipeline where none exists.
Familiarity with digital assets, tokenization, or a clear appetite to build expertise in bringing equity capital markets on-chain.
Collaborate with world-class talent in a user-centric global organization with a flat structure
Tackle challenging projects in a fast-paced and innovative enviornment with autonomy
Thrive in a results-driven workplace with opportunities for career growth and continuous learning
Remote-first, work-from-home arrangement (may vary depending on the nature of the role and team)

r: Originate and source deals — proactively identify and engage issuers, companies, partners, investment banks, exchanges, and distribution platforms to develop new opportunities.
Own external relationships — act as the primary point of contact and trusted counterpart, building and maintaining relationships across issuers, financial institutions, and strategic partners.
Negotiate deals — lead commercial negotiations and structure terms.
Grow and manage the deal pipeline — build a robust origination pipeline, track opportunities from lead through execution, and report on progress and conversion.
Support origination materials — prepare pitches, proposals, and partner-facing materials to win mandates and advance live opportunities.
Monitor the market — track pipeline, market conditions, comparable transactions, and competitor activity to identify and prioritize opportunities.
Coordinate execution — work cross-functionally with internal stakeholders to move deals through diligence, documentation, and closing.

Shape and execute revenue strategies that drive profitability, market share, and sustainable growth.
Analyze market trends, demand patterns, and competitor activity to identify opportunities and optimize performance.
Lead pricing, inventory, and distribution strategies to maximize revenue across all channels.
Oversee forecasting, budgeting, and performance analysis to support informed business decisions.
Partner closely with Sales, Marketing, and Operations to align commercial strategies and drive results.
Leverage data, insights, and technology to uncover new revenue opportunities and improve performance.
Monitor and optimize channel mix, distribution effectiveness, and commercial partnerships.
Deliver clear recommendations and actionable insights to the Executive Team.
Champion a culture of performance, innovation, and commercial excellence.
q: Bachelor's degree in Hospitality Management, Business Administration, Finance, Economics, or related field; Master's degree preferred
Proven experience (minimum 7+ years) in revenue management, financial planning, or related senior roles within a corporate or hospitality environment

Excellent analytical and problem-solving skills with the ability to interpret complex data and translate insights into actionable strategies
Exceptional communication and interpersonal skills, with the ability to effectively collaborate with diverse teams and stakeholders at all organizational levels

d: Cohorts: June (yearly) | Function: Multiple, apply once and tell us where you want to build

Tamara is Saudi Arabia's first FinTech unicorn, on a mission to help people own their dreams by building the most customer-centric financial super app in the world. There's no playbook for that; our Tamarians are writing it as we go, and we believe potential should be stretched early.

The Flagship Builders Program is our gateway for brilliant minds ready to kick-start their careers. Whether you're a recent graduate or early in your career with up to two years of experience, this is where you'll do real meaningful work, alongside some of the most ambitious people in the region.

This year, we’re keeping things simple: one application gets you into the running for any area you’re interested in. Just share a bit about yourself, highlight what you’re great at, and tell us which teams get you excited. We want you to work on what you’re passionate about, so we’ll look at your interests to match you with a role where you can jump in and start building.

Product: Get hands-on with how a fintech unicorn builds products people actually love. You'll support Product Managers in shaping features used by millions of shoppers, drawing on data and customer insight to explore areas for improvement, conceptualise new products, and dive into a wide range of financial services, from personal banking to brand new fintech solutions.

Engineering: Write code that ships. As part of our engineering team, you'll work alongside senior engineers on live projects, from feature builds to system improvements, gaining mentorship and real production experience from day one.

Design: Help design the experiences behind a product millions of people trust with their money. You'll contribute to real flows and interfaces, working closely with Product and Engineering to build seamless fintech solutions. You will dive directly into uncovering user needs, mapping out core user journeys, and rapidly iterating through wireframes.
Data: Get hands-on with the numbers behind millions of transactions. You'll support analytics and reporting that help teams understand customers, measure impact, and make better decisions.

Commercial: Our Commercial teams cover two sides of the same goal: Sales, where you'll help find, pitch, and sign new merchant partners, and Account Management, where you'll help look after existing partners and grow those relationships over time.
Marketing: Get hands-on with how a fintech unicorn tells its story. You'll support brand, growth, and campaign work that reaches customers and merchants across the region.

Finance & Accounting: Get inside the financial engine of a unicorn. You'll support month-end close, financial reporting, and audits, learning what it takes to keep a fast-scaling company's numbers accurate and controlled.

Strategy: Work close to the top. You'll contribute to market research, competitor benchmarking, and strategic projects that inform decisions made by Tamara's executive team: real exposure to strategic thinking at the highest level.
Note: The functions listed above aren't an exhaustive list. If you're interested in an area we haven't mentioned here, tell us on your application; we still want to hear from you.
q: A Bachelor's degree in a relevant field is desirable, but we value proven experience and capability just as highly
Up to 2 years of experience, including prior internships or co-ops
Passionate about continuous iteration and bringing a creative mindset to solving problems, no matter the function.

Strong analytical and problem-solving abilities, with a bias toward data-driven decisions
Excellent communication skills, written and verbal
Organisational skills: able to prioritise, multi-task, and work independently
Comfortable working with ambiguity and figuring things out as you go
Curious, driven, and genuinely excited to build

Resilient and adaptable: you find a way through, not around, a challenge
A collaborative team player who leads with empathy and respect
Goal-oriented, with high personal standards and the energy to match them
